current_state.zh: Go-ethereum v1.17.8 is a recommended security release that hardens multiple DoS vectors in the eth and snap p2p packet handlers, JUMPDEST analysis caching, IP address prediction, post-Amsterdam BAL account handling, and STUN response parsing, alongside correctness fixes for eth_createAccessList and eth_simulateV1.
